sentences.text:
Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Sarbottam Kumar Sarkar  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Sunil Kumar Pandey  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 12-03-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Khodawanpur (Chhorahi O.P.) P.S. Case No. 303 of 2022 registered for the offence under Sections 498A, 363, 365/34 of the Indian Penal Code and later Sections 302, 201/34 of the Indian Penal Code were also added.
3. As per the prosecution case, the in-laws of the deceased are said to have killed the deceased and have cremated her body.
4. The petitioner is not related to the in-laws of the deceased and he is the owner and driver of the vehicle by which the dead body of the deceased was taken for cremation.

Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.15087 of 2024(2) dt.12-03-2024 5.
The petitioner is in jail since 22.12.2023.
6. Considering the aforesaid facts, this application is allowed.
